jobs.referenceRole: Original q10 establishes observer eye line, horizontal distance, vertical target and elevation-angle semantics; do not reproduce stone tower or original scenery.
jobs.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: an authored illustration layer for a Korean middle-school math bank. Draw a simple, clear grayscale textbook scene of an observer looking up at a ventilation window on the vertical exterior wall of a gymnasium, with level ground and a visible eye level. Leave ample clean space for mathematical overlays. The new scene must be recognizable as a gym wall and window, not a stone tower, monument or copy of the reference landscape. Do not draw any numbers, letters, angles, dimension marks, text, school signs, logos or watermark. Mathematical rays, axes, distances and labels will be rendered separately from verified data. Use crisp economical linework with low-detail shading so the scene remains clear at about 70 mm print width.

mathematicalBinding.calculation: distance=(9.6-1.6)/1.6003; use supplied table then round to one decimal place
constraints: no pixel measurements used for answer

jobs.overlayPlan: Bind eye/window/ground anchors to exact points. Draw horizontal eye line, vertical height/difference, sight ray and 58° angle in the existing engine/label pipeline. Unknown distance stays unknown in labels. Recreate trig table with explicit display precision.

jobs.referenceRole: Original q19 establishes triangle/ground-map semantics. Replace tents/campground with park survey markers and a garden facility; do not copy original illustration objects or layout details.
jobs.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: an authored illustration layer for a Korean middle-school math bank. Draw a clean grayscale overhead-style park survey map with two distinct ground survey markers and a small garden irrigation control facility. Use restrained trees or park paths only to establish the new setting. Do not depict tents or a campground. Leave clear spaces at all three mathematical point anchors and along the eventual triangle edges. Do not draw any letters, numbers, angles, distances, connecting rays, text, school names, logos or watermark. The exact triangle and all labels will be rendered separately from verified geometric data. Use simple legible textbook linework that prints clearly at about 70 mm width.

constraints: exact underlying coordinates determine overlay geometry
illustration scale is not answer evidence

jobs.overlayPlan: Compute triangle points from the given side/angles, then bind decorative anchors. Draw A/B/C, 80m and 45°/75° in vector/label composition. The student solution drops a perpendicular from B to AC and uses 45°/60° right-triangle ratios; no sine/cosine law or trig addition formula.
